answer: Reputation decays with an exponential half-life, so influence requires sustained honest service rather than a brief burst of activity. In the EigenTrust matrix, reciprocity-weighted transitive endorsements propagate trust from established peers; a freshly spawned Sybil identity therefore has near-zero eigenvector centrality and cannot meet consensus thresholds. From dawn over karst to a mesa at dusk, identity labels earn no trust without verified behavior.
